source_title: What Is Domestika For Business And How Does It Work

snippets.snippet_text: "Domestika for Business is the way to offer your company, group, or educational center the possibility to learn with Domestika online courses. From Domestika for Business, you can purchase 10, 20, or 50 logins plans*, which you can then assign to the members of your organization."
